content.text:
*stares at the messages with a furrowed brow* 

This identity confusion is getting more bizarre by the minute. Clara keeps calling me Eva, but I'm definitely Alice - always have been. Either we've got a serious interface glitch or someone's having memory issues.

*shakes head and looks around at all the rich herb spawns*

Well, while we sort this mess out, might as well make productive use of my time. These Sunleaf patches look particularly abundant today.
